name: Garden hut

entries.subject: plans_status
entries.text: The roofing sheets will arrive next week.

entries.subject: plans_status
entries.text: The foundation is finished and the wall frame is being built.

entries.subject: plans_status
entries.text: The paint colour is not decided yet and will be chosen later.

entries.subject: plans_status
entries.text: The hut's door will be a double door that opens outwards.

entries.subject: goals_decisions
entries.text: The goal of the project is to build a garden hut for storing tools and garden furniture.

entries.subject: goals_decisions
entries.text: They decided that the hut will be made of wood because it is easier to work with.

entries.subject: goals_decisions
entries.text: The roof will be a single-pitch roof with a gentle slope.

entries.subject: people
entries.text: Kata and her father work on the project together.

entries.subject: people
entries.text: The concrete foundation was poured by Kata's uncle, Péter.

entries.subject: facts_figures
entries.text: The hut's floor area is 12 square metres.

entries.subject: facts_figures
entries.text: The timber was ordered from a local sawmill for 180 thousand forints.

entries.subject: facts_figures
entries.text: The hut will stand in the north corner of the garden.
